title: Capital headroom and bank cost of equity: Evidence from the Euro Area
Do Banks Practice What They Preach? Brown Lending and Environmental Disclosure in the Euro Area
abstract: This study examines whether the level of environmental disclosure in banks’ financial reports matches less brown lending portfolios. Using granular credit register data and detailed information on firm-level greenhouse gas emission intensities, we find a negative relationship between environmental disclosure and brown lending. However, this effect is contingent on the tone of the financial report. Banks that express a negative tone, reflecting genuine concern and awareness of environmental risks, tend to lend less to more polluting firms. Conversely, banks that express a positive tone, indicating lower concern and awareness of environmental risks, tend to lend more to polluting firms. These findings highlight the importance of increasing awareness of environmental risks, so that banks perceive them as a critical and urgent pressing threat, leading to a genuine commitment to act as environmentally responsible lenders.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了银行财务报告中的环境信息披露水平是否与较少的棕色贷款组合相匹配。利用细粒度的信贷登记数据，并结合企业层面的温室气体排放强度详细信息，我们发现环境信息披露与棕色贷款之间存在负相关关系。然而，这一效应取决于财务报告的语气。语气消极、反映出对环境风险的真正关切和认识的银行，倾向于向污染较重的企业放贷较少。相反，语气积极、表明对环境风险关注度较低的银行，则倾向于向污染企业放贷更多。这些发现凸显了提高环境风险意识的重要性，使银行将环境风险视为关键且紧迫的威胁，从而真正承诺成为具有环境责任感的贷款机构。

Are low interest rates firing back? Interest rate risk in the banking book and bank lending in a rising interest rate environment
abstract: We match granular supervisory and credit register data to assess the implications of banks’ exposure to interest rate risk on the monetary policy transmission to bank lending supply in the euro area. We exploit the largest and swiftest increase in interest rates since the creation of the euro and find that banks with a higher exposure to interest rate risk, i.e., with a larger duration gap after accounting for hedging, curtailed corporate lending more than their peers. Ceteris paribus, greater interest rate risk entails closer supervisory scrutiny and potential capital surcharges in the short term, and lower expected profitability and capital accumulation in the medium to long term. We then proceed to dissect banks’ credit allocation and find that banks with higher net duration reshuffled their loan portfolio away from long-term loans in an attempt to limit the increase in interest rate risk and targetedtheir lending contraction to small and micro firms. Firms exposed to banks with a larger exposure to interest rate risk were unable to fully rebalance their borrowing needs with other lenders, thus experiencing a relatively larger decrease in total borrowing during the monetary tightening episode.
abstract_zh: 我们将细粒度的监管数据与信贷登记数据相匹配，以评估银行利率风险敞口对欧元区货币政策向银行信贷供给传导的影响。我们利用欧元诞生以来规模最大、速度最快的一轮利率上升，发现利率风险敞口较大的银行（即在考虑对冲后久期缺口较大的银行）相比同业更大幅度地压缩了企业贷款。在其他条件不变的情况下，更大的利率风险意味着更严格的监管审查，并可能在短期内面临资本附加要求，同时在中长期内预期盈利能力和资本积累下降。随后，我们剖析了银行的信贷配置，发现净久期较高的银行为了限制利率风险的上升，将其贷款组合从长期贷款转向其他类型，并将信贷紧缩集中于小微企业。与利率风险敞口较大银行有往来的企业，无法完全通过其他贷款机构来调整其借款需求，因此在货币紧缩期间，其总借款的降幅相对更大。

Does gender diversity in the workplace mitigate climate change?
abstract: We match firm-corporate governance characteristics with firm-level carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions over the period 2009-2019 to study the relationship between gender diversity in the workplace and firm carbon emissions. We find that a 1 percentage point increase in the percentage of female managers within the firm leads to a 0.5% decrease in CO2 emissions. We document that this effect is statically significant, also when controlling for institutional differences caused by more patriarchal and hierarchical cultures and religions. At the same time, we show that gender diversity at the managerial level has stronger mitigating effects on climate change if females are also well-represented outside the organization, e.g. in political institutions and civil society organizations. Finally, we find that, after the Paris Agreement, firms with greater gender diversity reduced their CO2 emissions by about 5% more than firms with more male managers.
abstract_zh: 我们将企业公司治理特征与2009至2019年间企业层面的二氧化碳（CO2）排放数据相匹配，以研究职场性别多样性与企业碳排放之间的关系。我们发现，企业内女性管理者比例每提高1个百分点，CO2排放量便下降0.5%。我们记录到，即使控制了由更父权制和等级制的文化及宗教所造成的制度差异，这一效应在统计上依然显著。同时，我们表明，如果女性在组织外部（例如在政治机构和民间社会组织中）也有较好的代表性，管理层的性别多样性对缓解气候变化的作用会更强。最后，我们发现，在《巴黎协定》签署之后，性别多样性较高的企业减排幅度比男性管理者较多的企业多约5%。

title: Gender diversity in bank boardrooms and green lending: evidence from euro area credit register data
abstract: Do female directors on banks’ boards influence lending decisions toward less polluting firms? By using granular credit register data matched with information on firm-level greenhouse gas (GHG) emission intensities, we isolate credit supply shifts and find that banks with more gender-diverse boards provide less credit to browner companies. This evidence is robust when we differentiate among types of GHG emissions and control for endogeneity concerns. In addition, we also show that female director-specific characteristics matter for lending behavior to polluting firms as better-educated directors grant lower credit volumes to more polluting firms. Finally, we document that the “greening” effect of the female members in banks’ boardrooms is stronger in countries with more female climate-oriented politicians.
abstract_zh: 银行董事会中的女性董事是否会影响其对污染较少企业的贷款决策？借助细粒度的信贷登记数据，并与企业层面的温室气体（GHG）排放强度信息相匹配，我们分离出信贷供给的变动，发现董事会性别多样性更高的银行，向污染更重的企业提供的信贷更少。这一证据在区分不同类型温室气体排放并控制内生性问题后依然稳健。此外，我们还表明，女性董事的个人特征对其向污染企业放贷的行为也有影响：受教育程度更高的董事向污染更重的企业发放的贷款规模更小。最后，我们记录到，在女性气候导向型政治人物更多的国家，银行董事会中女性成员的“绿色化”效应更强。

title: A new measure for gauging the riskiness of European Banks' sovereign bond portfolios
Banks' noninterest income and securities holdings in a low interest rate environment: The case of Italy
abstract: Using a sample of 440 Italian banks over the period 2007–2016, we find that low interest rates motivate banks to expand their fee and commission income and to restructure their securities portfolios. A granular breakdown suggests that banks grow noninterest income in various ways, including portfolio management, brokerage and consultancy services and increase fee income from current account and payment services. In addition, banks rebalance securities portfolios away from those “held for trading” to securities “available for sale” and “held to maturity.” Our findings allude to different behavior between large and small banks: while larger banks increase brokerage, consultancy and portfolio management services, smaller banks generate fees from customer current accounts.
abstract_zh: 利用2007至2016年间440家意大利银行的样本，我们发现低利率促使银行扩大手续费和佣金收入，并重组其证券组合。细分数据表明，银行通过多种方式增加非利息收入，包括投资组合管理、经纪及咨询服务，并增加来自活期账户和支付服务的手续费收入。此外，银行将证券组合从“交易性”证券调整为“可供出售”和“持有至到期”类证券。我们的研究结果还表明，大型银行与小型银行的行为有所不同：大型银行增加了经纪、咨询和投资组合管理服务，而小型银行则主要通过客户活期账户获取手续费。
